description: This file is a Gradle build script written in Groovy that automates downloading and extracting machine learning model files from a remote URL into specified asset directories for an Android project.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Defines a Gradle task to download specified model files from a remote URL into a temporary directory.

methods.name: extractModels
methods.description: Defines a Gradle task to extract downloaded ZIP model files into the asset directory, depending on whether the files exist.
